meta.note: Traits are scored 0-100 for the student and 0-5 for each course profile. 'interest' traits follow Holland Codes (RIASEC). 'skill' traits are school-subject strengths. 'niche' traits separate look-alike courses (for example Animal Biology vs Microbiology).

traits.label: Hands-on (Realistic)
traits.description: Likes building, fixing, tools, outdoors and physical work.

traits.label: Analytical (Investigative)
traits.description: Likes figuring things out, research, experiments and hard problems.

traits.label: Creative (Artistic)
traits.description: Likes designing, drawing, making and original ideas.

traits.label: Helping (Social)
traits.description: Likes teaching, listening, guiding and serving people.

traits.label: Leading (Enterprising)
traits.description: Likes leading, persuading, business and taking initiative.

traits.label: Organized (Conventional)
traits.description: Likes order, rules, accuracy and working with data or records.

traits.label: Math
traits.description: Comfort with numbers, formulas and logic.

traits.label: Science
traits.description: Interest and strength in biology, chemistry and physics.

traits.label: Language and Communication
traits.description: Reading, writing and speaking clearly in English.

traits.label: Computing
traits.description: Comfort with computers, software and coding.

traits.label: Mechanical and Technical
traits.description: Understanding how machines and tools work.

traits.label: Theory and Study Stamina
traits.description: Willingness to study theory deeply and prepare for board or licensure exams.

traits.label: Animals
traits.description: Caring for and studying animals.

traits.label: Microbes and Lab Work
traits.description: Cells, bacteria and microscope work.

traits.label: Vehicles and Engines
traits.description: Cars, motorcycles and engines.

traits.label: Buildings and Construction
traits.description: Structures, plans and construction.

traits.label: Electricity and Electronics
traits.description: Circuits, wiring and gadgets.

traits.label: Signals and Communications

traits.label: Cooling Systems

traits.label: Food and Hospitality

traits.label: Teaching Children
